comments.author: Xiao Wei
comments.body: hey i have a question, as this quest requires indian language will i get away with body language skill as a substitute? ty in advanced

comments.author: Cornelia
comments.body: Unless it involves any sort of reading like at an archive (most maritime quests usually don't; otherwise you would need the proper language), you should be able to pull it off with just body language. I know some quests are easier to get if you have the language though.
